attr.title: Open Surge
attr.desc: Open Surge is a fun 2D retro platformer inspired by Sonic games, and a game creation system. Play as Surge the Rabbit, a hero who uses his electric powers to rescue his friends from an evil robot.
attr.inst: Ready to run. To play other Open Surge games, drop their .zip/.7z file or folder into opensurge/games and pick them from the menu shown on launch.
